reason: INCIDENT: job-permission living card re-raised an identical edit revision every reconciler tick (10k Telegram edits of one KnackLabs card overnight). reviseLivingCard compares JSON.stringify(last.rows) to a fresh literal; Postgres JSONB normalizes key order so the no-op guard never matches. Fix: key-order-insensitive compare (util.isDeepStrictEqual) + make the in-memory repository fakes round-trip state like JSONB so the suite catches this class.
